<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> Indian indices extended their losing streak to a fourth session, with the Nifty falling below 23,900 and the Sensex shedding over 360 points as surging Brent crude prices and FII outflows of ₹2,999 crore dampened sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Regulatory Proposals:</strong> SEBI has proposed a new framework for Portfolio Management Services (PMS) with a lower ₹25 lakh entry threshold and is considering waiving upfront margins for cash market trades to enhance liquidity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I18</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Economic Outlook:</strong> The RBI’s latest report projects FY27 growth at 6.6% while highlighting concerns over 4.4% inflation and the impact of high oil prices on forex reserves and the rupee, which is currently trading near 96.49.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxOY1VkNXdDcGN2bXRDdVdvejBxZ1Bocm94S2RNUERlX09xRFpaQW5QakxQZWlnTzB5WW1XZDVHOXdIdFRpaVBHbW1VVmtxUU5hTllZcm1IejlBR2h2WW00Z1ZQMXNKYTlJczM0TXhWX3p4cTR4REhQdmNpWFdtdDNQdG9rYVVrS050cjl2WjhzYWlwSk5OS3BNOGk3bVF0bVRpaEtnMVVKaHJsYWJmNDlVWGt3UF9NVEpmYV9YeHZNTjJRdnhlRS01TQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I36</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I38</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I42</a></span></li>
</ul>
